business_problem: Syslabo needed to replace a 30-year-old legacy sales support stack, remove silos between separate sales tools, and give business users a practical way to build and improve internal applications without long specialist development cycles.
solution_summary: Syslabo standardized internal application delivery on ServiceNow App Engine and used Now Assist for Creator with AI Agents to modernize both development and workflow design. The company rebuilt sales support and sales management processes on App Engine after testing multiple approaches, then used workshops to let sales specialists and certified engineers prototype applications together. Now Assist for Creator generates code, flows, playbooks, and app prototypes so citizen developers can move from ideas to working designs more quickly, while App Engine provides the shared workflow and data foundation for requests such as business cards, device loans, and paid leave. The target architecture consolidates sales, HR, and admin information into one database so teams can reuse data, reduce duplicate entry, and extend successful patterns into future customer-facing solutions.

solution_components.name: App Engine
solution_components.role: Provides the application platform used to rebuild sales support systems and internal workflows.

solution_components.name: Now Assist for Creator
solution_components.role: Generates code, flows, playbooks, and application prototypes to speed development for both expert and citizen developers.

data_flow: Sales and internal operations requirements are modeled in App Engine, where Now Assist for Creator and AI Agents generate prototypes, code, and workflow logic. The resulting applications write shared records into a single database spanning sales, HR, and admin processes, and employees use those workflows for requests such as business cards, device loans, and paid leave.
business_outcome: Syslabo cut application prototyping time in half, doubled App Engine onboarding speed with AI assistance, and expanded citizen-development participation while creating a repeatable blueprint for both internal and customer-oriented application delivery.
